newsitem.title: USA: Synalloy sees better Q4 chemical results.
newsitem.headline: Synalloy sees better Q4 chemical results.

text.p: Synalloy Corp said on Friday that assuming that flat rolled stainless steel prices do not decline further, the pressure on profit margins from inventory losses should be over before the end of the fourth quarter.

A competitive market environment forced prices of stainless steel pipe down 25 percent from the year earlier level, leading to losses on inventory contrasting with profits on inventory a year ago as prices increased rapidly, the company said.
Under these conditions the company said it is pleased with the 10 percent operating margin achieved in this year's third quarter.
Because of scheduled production, the fourth quarter should produce much better results from specialties in the company's Chemical Segment.

The company said it is confident the third quarter results will prove to be an aberration, with the fourth quarter improving substantially on a sequential basis, as well as compared with the $777,000 operating income in the fourth quarter of 1995.
